sources.shortCitation: Electrola EG 2135, “Ach, Otto, Otto…!” (Marek Weber with Siegfried Arno, 1931)
sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, refrain sung by Siegfried Arno. “Ach, Otto, Otto…!” Foxtrot; Electrola EG 2135, matrix BD 9264-2, playing time 3:12; recorded in the Beethoven-Saal, Berlin, and released in January 1931; also issued as His Master's Voice AM 3450. Music by Bronisław Kaper, words by Fritz Rotter. Entry in the Electrola label list and the title list at musiktiteldb.de, both following the Discographie der deutschen Kleinkunst, vol. 1. Accessed 21 August 2026.
sources.title: Ach, Otto, Otto…! — Electrola EG 2135
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester; Siegfried Arno, refrain vocal

sources.fullCitation: HeadHunter131, uploader. “Siegfried Arno: Ach Otto Otto!” YouTube video, uploaded 11 August 2008. The upload gives no label, catalogue or matrix number; the discographic literature records a single performance of the song by Siegfried Arno, the Electrola disc EG 2135 with Marek Weber und sein Orchester. Accessed 21 August 2026.

contributions.scopeNote: Sang the refrain on the Electrola disc, credited in the Berlin form of his name.

personNameVariants.publicNote: The Berlin form of the actor's name, under which he sang on German records before his emigration; the Library of Congress heading gives the later American form Sig Arno.
